text: @harzva/dsh-session-folders（DSH 网页插件）：为会话提供持久化文件夹。插件将文件夹和会话归属保存在 DSH settings 中，并通过 connection RPC 连接主机与网页界面。用户可在设置页创建、重命名、删除文件夹，也可移动当前会话；删除文件夹会把其会话放回收件箱。适合想按项目整理会话的 DSH 网页用户，需有 settings 与 connection 服务，无需额外密钥。

@harzva/dsh-session-folders (DSH web plugin): organizes sessions into persistent folders saved through DSH settings. Users manage folders on a settings page and move the current session from its header action; removing a folder returns its sessions to the inbox. Requires DSH settings and connection.
想把 DSH 会话按项目放进不同文件夹。
I want to organize my DSH sessions into project folders.
能不能给当前会话指定一个文件夹，之后再从设置里管理？
@harzva/dsh-session-folders 的功能「会话文件夹管理」：可在网页设置页创建、重命名和删除文件夹，并查看和维护会话归属；删除文件夹后，其会话会回到收件箱。

@harzva/dsh-session-folders README · dsh-session-folders：给 DeepSeek Harness (DSH) 的会话加一层「文件夹」归类。会话可以按 cwd 自动归档、手动移动到任意文件夹；文件夹路径即项目记忆作用域钩子。

A self-contained folder layer for DSH sessions: sessions file under folders (`''` = inbox), auto-file by working directory, and each folder path doubles as the project-memory scope.

@harzva/dsh-session-folders README · What it deliberately does not do (yet)：The **sidebar "group by folder" tree** is not provided by this plugin. DSH's `sidebar.workspaces` region owns the session list and exposes no additive inner seat for a folder tree, so that grouping requires a core slot patch — which is why the folder model is split between this plugin (durable registry + management UI) and any future core slot.
section: What it deliberately does not do (yet)

@harzva/dsh-session-folders README · Install：```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add <tarball-or-github-url>
```

For users on the Harzva release:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:Harzva/dsh-session-folders
```

```
